tests.name: packaging line completion in the database (tablets 1230) > [IN-16] start, middle and end coding specimens are required, in that order, each showing the record's batch number, manufacture date and expiry; the step does not close without them
packaging line completion in the database (tablets 1230) > [PR-16] removing one label specimen or one checker signature blocks completion and names the gap

packaging line completion in the database (tablets 1230) > [PR-34] closing an order without the post-use inspection is blocked; a failed or unverified inspection blocks it too; the inspection is recorded after printing ended and verified by another person

packaging line completion in the database (tablets 1230) > [PR-36] a wrong expiry on a test unit is rejected by vision and stops the line: the gateway's EXPIRY_REJECTED opens a line stop; no job is released and the step does not close until QA resolves it with a reason

packaging line completion in the database (tablets 1230) > [PR-39] the waiver without a qualifying device is refused: not a vision or reader device, no passing challenge on a job of the step, or an item not declared for a 100 % electronic inspection; it records the device and its challenge and never switches the reconciliation off

packaging line completion in the database (tablets 1230) > [PR-36][IN-31] a print job carries an approved label template the master names for its step, with every record field the template binds (D-P6c-16)
packaging line completion in the database (tablets 1230) > [PR-42] a pool the L3 system issues with a duplicate serial is refused and nothing is recorded (the simulator's DUPLICATE_SERIAL fault)

G-21 when time passes and steps and the batch close (recipe-core 0581, tablets 0952) > [IN-22][PR-37] a scheduled challenge not done within its interval (at database time) is MISSED: the late challenge carries the exception that stops the step, the line unit records MISSED and the output since the last good challenge is held; a forged engine that calls it on time, or drops the exception, is refused

G-21 when time passes and steps and the batch close (recipe-core 0581, tablets 0952) > [PR-40][IN-22][INV-32] the destruction step of the coded surplus closes only when it destroyed exactly the coded quantity the reconciliation counts; coded material is never returned to stores, not even through a forged engine

G-21 when time passes and steps and the batch close (recipe-core 0581, tablets 0952) > [PR-42] the packaging order does not reach EXECUTION_COMPLETE while its serial pool is unreconciled: a serial event after the closed report its step closed on leaves the pool open, and a newer report the record does not reconcile keeps it so; a clean order completes

G-21 when time passes and steps and the batch close (recipe-core 0581, tablets 0952) > [IN-22][PR-37] a G-21 step does not close while a failed challenge result of its devices is not recorded: the FAIL becomes an entry, with its exception and its hold

G-21 when time passes and steps and the batch close (recipe-core 0581, tablets 0952) > [IN-31] an MRP a person gives is checked by a second person before a print job carries it, and its giver, though holding the rights to check and release, neither checks nor releases

G-21 when time passes and steps and the batch close (recipe-core 0581, tablets 0952) > [L-29][PR-36] the database refuses a print job on a G-21 step whose stored configuration names no plant unit of the line (arranged past the engine, which refuses such a master), so a batch-data change can always hold

G-21 when time passes and steps and the batch close (recipe-core 0581, tablets 0952) > [PR-42] without a configured L3 system (EBMR_L3_URL unset) serialisation is off: a pool request is refused with a clear reason and nothing is recorded; the URL is read from the environment, https only in production

labels routes (GMP) > [IN-31] the designer saves template versions through the route; an India-domestic template without its manufacturing date shows why it fails and is refused approval; a complete one is approved by QA, never by its designer
labels routes (GMP) > [PR-32] an unauthorised user cannot open a label-store transaction through the route; the label store receives and issues
labels routes (GMP) > [PR-34] the packaging completion and master labelling views answer only for a known batch and version
